Privacy
notice.

Last updated: 15 October 2026. This notice describes the behaviour of this presentation website as currently published.

Information submitted on this website

The executive-brief form runs locally in your browser. Its contents are not transmitted to or stored by ThinkAnas Health. Copying, sharing or emailing the generated brief is an action you initiate through your own device and chosen service.

Local preference

The site may store one language preference in your browser’s local storage. This is used only to remember whether you selected English or Arabic. The current site does not set advertising or analytics cookies.

External links

The site links to LinkedIn. When you follow an external link, that service applies its own terms and privacy practices.

Hosting and technical logs

The hosting provider may process limited technical request information required to deliver and secure the website. Do not enter patient-identifiable, clinical or otherwise sensitive data into the brief generator.

Contact and future services

If a direct contact form, analytics service or scheduling service is introduced later, this notice must be updated before that processing begins.
